title: automation: switching off a packaged flow or a packaged action writes the activation-ledger row and its audit row with a null actor, so nothing records which admin did it
body:
When an authenticated admin switches off a packaged flow or a packaged action, nothing records who did it. Both the activation-ledger row and the audit-log row come out with their actor fields null:

| row | written | actor fields |
|---|---|---|
| `sys_metadata_activation` | yes | `created_by` null, `updated_by` null |
| `sys_audit_log` (action `create`, object `sys_metadata_activation`) | yes | `user_id` null, `actor` null |

So the audit trail cannot say which administrator disabled a shipped artifact. The same session's own sign-in rows, by contrast, carry the admin's user id.

QA-source: #26468 · automation.setup-packaged-automation-board · observed beside the clauses

## Reproduction (framework 756220c4, stock showcase, fresh file DB)

1. Boot: `OS_PORT=41566 pnpm -C examples/app-showcase exec objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin -p 41566 -d file:/tmp/x/data.db`.
2. Sign in as the admin: `POST /api/v1/auth/sign-in/email {"email":"admin@objectos.ai","password":"admin123"}`. Use the returned token as Bearer. `GET /api/v1/auth/get-session` names the admin's user id, here `U1Pek…`.
3. Toggle a packaged flow: `POST /api/v1/automation/showcase_urgent_task_alert/toggle {"enabled":false}` answers 200 `{"name":"showcase_urgent_task_alert","enabled":false}`.
4. Toggle a packaged action: `POST /api/v1/actions/_activation/sys_member/add_member {"enabled":false}` answers 200.
5. Read the ledger: `GET /api/v1/data/sys_metadata_activation?top=200`. Both rows (`showcase_urgent_task_alert`, `add_member`) read `active:false`, `created_by: null`, `updated_by: null`.
6. Read the audit log: `GET /api/v1/data/sys_audit_log?top=20&$orderby=created_at desc`. Two `create` rows on `sys_metadata_activation`, timestamped at the toggles, read `user_id: null`, `actor: null`. The neighbouring `login` / `sys_user update` rows of the same request window carry `user_id: U1Pek…`.

- **Expected:** the ledger row's `created_by`/`updated_by` and the audit row's `user_id`/`actor` name the admin who made the request.
- **Actual:** all null.

The QA runner found this through the Setup › Packaged Automation page, and I reproduced it on an independent fresh boot over the API alone. The runner also observed that saving a clone of a packaged flow is audited as actor `system`.

## Likely shape (to confirm)

The toggle and activation doors appear to write the ledger under a system context, not the caller's. Compare #7749 (a bearer-authenticated `/meta` PUT stamped `actor: 'system'`), which was the same class on a different door.

Full evidence chain: the run record named in the QA-source line above.
